title: Object-Centric Video Prediction via Decoupling of Object Dynamics and Interactions
venueFull: IEEE International Conference on Image Processing (ICIP)
summary: An object-centric video prediction framework with two transformer predictors (OCVP) that model object dynamics and object interactions separately. It beats object-agnostic video prediction models on two datasets while keeping object representations consistent.
